name: Reconciliation Repair Validation
notes: 当前实现不自动执行 Repair。所有 RepairAction 为声明式策略标记，由 DataLifecycle Executor 等已有系统间接完成修复。故所有违规计数器为 0。

dataLifecycleIndirectRepairPath.path: Reconciliation → diff marked → DataLifecycle Coordinator picks up → executes cleanup/recalculation
dataLifecycleIndirectRepairPath.verification: DataLifecycle Executor 自身有幂等保证
